```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

options(scipen=999)
```

## ATUS Data
Reference for data descriptions: https://www.bls.gov/tus/data/datafiles-0324.htm

Data files google drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1RYAvKluPasULGk68OPw5b8FkcoFuPK16?usp=drive_link

```{r import}
resp <- read.delim('atusresp-0324/atusresp_0324.dat', sep=",")
rost <- read.delim('atusrost-0324/atusrost_0324.dat', sep=",")
activity <- read.delim('atusact-0324/atusact_0324.dat', sep=",")
who <- read.delim('atuswho-0324/atuswho_0324.dat', sep=",")
```

```{r cleaning columns}
rost <- rost |> filter(TULINENO == 1)
who <- who |> filter(TULINENO == 1)

rost <- rost |> select(TUCASEID, TEAGE, TESEX)
rost <- rost |> rename(id = TUCASEID,
               age = TEAGE,
               gender = TESEX)

resp <- resp |> select(TUCASEID, TUDIARYDATE, TUYEAR, TUMONTH, TUDIARYDAY, TEHRUSLT, TELFS, TESCHENR, TRHHCHILD, TRMJOCC1, TRTALONE, TUFNWGTP, TU20FWGT)
resp <- resp |> rename(id = TUCASEID,
               date = TUDIARYDATE,
               year = TUYEAR,
               month = TUMONTH,
               day_of_wk = TUDIARYDAY,
               work_hrs_per_wk = TEHRUSLT,
               work_status = TELFS,
               student_status = TESCHENR,
               children_under_18 = TRHHCHILD,
               occupation = TRMJOCC1,
               nonwork_time_alone = TRTALONE,
               weight = TUFNWGTP,
               weight_for_2020 = TU20FWGT
               )

activity <- activity |> select(TUCASEID, TUACTIVITY_N, TRCODEP, TRTIER1P, TRTIER2P, TEWHERE, TUACTDUR, TUCUMDUR, TUSTARTTIM, TUSTOPTIME, TUCC5)
activity <- activity |> rename(id = TUCASEID,
                   activity_line_num = TUACTIVITY_N,
                   activity = TRCODEP,
                   first_two_digits_activity = TRTIER1P,
                   first_four_digits_activity = TRTIER2P,
                   location = TEWHERE,
                   duration = TUACTDUR,
                   cum_duration =TUCUMDUR,
                   start_time = TUSTARTTIM,
                   stop_time = TUSTOPTIME,
                   with_children = TUCC5
                   )

who <- who |> select(TUCASEID, TUACTIVITY_N, TUWHO_CODE)
who <- who |> rename(id = TUCASEID,
              activity_line_num = TUACTIVITY_N,
              with_whom = TUWHO_CODE)
```

```{r merge}
activity <- left_join(activity, who, by = c("id", "activity_line_num")) # merge activity and who data
resp <- left_join(resp, rost, by = "id") |> relocate(c(age, gender), .after = id) # merge resp and roster data

activity <- left_join(activity, resp, by = "id") #merge activity and resp data
activity <- activity |> relocate(activity_line_num:with_whom, .after = last_col())
```

```{r cleaning1}
activity$gender <- factor(activity$gender,
                               levels = c(1, 2),        
                               labels = c("M", "F"))

activity <- activity |> mutate(date = ymd(date))
activity$day_of_wk <- factor(activity$day_of_wk,
                             levels = c(1:7),
                             labels = c("Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"))

```

```{r cleaning2}
activity_2020_24 <- activity |> filter(year %in% 2020:2024) |> filter(first_two_digits_activity %in% c(11, 12, 13, 15, 18)) #filter from 2020 to 2024 & leisure-related activities

# activity_2020_24 |> distinct(first_two_digits_activity) |> arrange(first_two_digits_activity)
# activity_2020_24 |> distinct(first_four_digits_activity) |> arrange(first_four_digits_activity)
# activity_2020_24 |> distinct(activity) |> arrange(activity)

activity_2020_24 <- activity_2020_24 |> mutate(first_two_digits_classification = factor(activity_2020_24$first_two_digits_activity,
                             levels = c(11, 12, 13, 15, 18),
                             labels = c("Eating and Drinking", "Socializing, Relaxing, and Leisure", "Sports, Exercise, & Recreation", "Volunteer Activities", "Traveling"))) |> relocate(first_two_digits_classification, .after = first_two_digits_activity) # re-coding first two digits

activity_2020_24 |> count(first_four_digits_activity)

activity_2020_24 <- activity_2020_24 |> filter(first_four_digits_activity %in% c(1101, 1201, 1202, 1203, 1204, 1301, 1302, 1501, 1801, 1802, 1811, 1812, 1813, 1814, 1815)) # filtering leisure related activities

activity_2020_24 <- activity_2020_24 |> mutate(first_four_digits_classifications = recode(first_four_digits_activity,
                           `1101` = "Eating and Drinking",
                           `1201` = "Socializing and Communicating",
                           `1202` = "Attending or Hosting Social Events",
                           `1203` = "Relaxing and Leisure",
                           `1204` = "Arts and Entertainment",
                           `1301` = "Participating in Sports, Exercise, and Recreation",
                           `1302` = "Attending Sports/Recreational Events",
                           `1801` = "Travel Related to Personal Care",
                           `1802` = "Travel Related to Household Activities",
                           `1811` = "Travel Related to Eating and Drinking",
                           `1812` = "Travel Related to Socializing, Relaxing, and Leisure",
                           `1813` = "Travel Related to Sports, Exercise, and Recreation",
                           `1814` = "Travel Related to Religious/Spiritual Activities",
                           `1815` = "Travel Related to Volunteer Activities")) |> 
  relocate(first_four_digits_classifications, .after = first_four_digits_activity) # re-coding

activity_2020_24 |> count(first_four_digits_classifications)
# key activity code: 12, 13 => need to recode them in detail.
```

```{r cleaning4}
activity_2020_24 <- activity_2020_24 |> mutate(location_detail = factor(activity_2020_24$location,
                             levels = c(1:21, 30, 31, 32),
                             labels = c("Respondent's home or yard",
                                        "Respondent's workplace",
                                        "Someone else's home",
                                        "Restaurant or bar",
                                        "Place of worship",
                                        "Grocery store",
                                        "Other store/mall",
                                        "School",
                                        "Outdoors away from home",
                                        "Library",
                                        "Tourist spots/other place",
                                        "Car, truck, or motorcycle (driver)",
                                        "Car, truck, or motorcycle (passenger)",
                                        "Walking",
                                        "Bus",
                                        "Subway/train",
                                        "Bicycle",
                                        "Boat/ferry",
                                        "Taxi/limousine service",
                                        "Airplane",
                                        "Other mode of transportation",
                                        "Bank",
                                        "Gym/health club",
                                        "Post Office"
                                        ))) |> relocate(location_detail, .after = location) # re-coding locations

activity_2020_24$student_status <- factor(activity_2020_24$student_status,
                               levels = c(1, 2),        
                               labels = c("Yes", "No"))

activity_2020_24$work_status <- factor(activity_2020_24$work_status,
                               levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),        
                               labels = c("Employed", "Employed", "Unemployed", "Unemployed", "Not in labor force"))
```


```{r cleaning5 }
# convert min to hours (nonwork time & duration & cum_duration)
activity_2020_24 <- activity_2020_24 |> mutate(nonwork_time_hours = round(nonwork_time_alone / 60, 1)) |> relocate(nonwork_time_hours, .after = nonwork_time_alone)

activity_2020_24 <- activity_2020_24 |> mutate(duration_hours = round(duration / 60, 1)) |> relocate(duration_hours, .after = duration)

activity_2020_24 <- activity_2020_24 |> mutate(cum_duration_hours = round(cum_duration / 60, 1)) |> relocate(cum_duration_hours, .after = cum_duration)
```

```{r inspect}
activity_2020_24 |> filter(!is.na(activity_detail)) |> group_by(activity_detail) |> count() |> arrange(desc(n))

activity_2020_24 |> filter(!is.na(location_detail)) |> group_by(location_detail) |> count() |> arrange(desc(n))

activity_2020_24 |> filter(!is.na(location_detail) & !is.na(activity_detail)) |> group_by(location_detail, activity_detail) |> count() |> arrange(desc(n))

activity_2020_24 |> filter(activity == 120402)
activity_2020_24 |> filter(location_detail == "Tourist spots/other place") |> group_by(activity_detail) |> count() |> arrange(desc(n))
```

```{r}
write_csv(activity_2020_24, "atus_activity_2020_24.csv")
```
